issue: An intermediate reachability diagnostic incorrectly treated the structural SEARCH detector as the only production eligibility path.
production_behavior: The OpenAI Responses handler enriches a candidate when either the output is structurally SEARCH-like OR its call_id belongs to a recognized Bash rg/grep search call.
correction: U01 search output is production-handler eligible because its producing call is a Bash rg search, despite structural_search_eligible=false.
effect_on_benchmark: No agent condition was rerun, replaced, or modified. U01-OFF and U01-ON remain the only consumed second-unseen task conditions.
outcome_interpretation: Handler-level applicability reproduced, but the final relevance_split preservation treatment did not activate in U01-ON.
